*.md: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- md mermaid validate --exclude "apps/ayokoding-www/content"
cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- md heading-hierarchy validate
cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- md naming validate --exempt "*__linkedin__*.md"
cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- md frontmatter validate
*.{json,toml,ts,tsx,js,jsx,mjs,cjs,rs,go: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- convention emoji validate
*.feature: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- specs gherkin-cardinality validate
docker-compose*.{yml,yaml}: bash -c 'for f; do docker compose -f "$f" config > /dev/null; done' --
apps/*/package.json: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- git lockfile sync
